Both structures are printed in this chapter's own body text on p.266 (embedded rasters, xref 316 and xref 322), but ~470 pt apart, so no single bbox holds both: each is cropped with the book's own pink caption and the two are stacked into one composite by scripts/mh-sb-11/_kt_ecl_solfig.py. "Draw the structure of BHT" — same case. Cropped from the chapter's own printed BHT structure on p.264 (embedded raster xref 249) with its caption. Worth recording so nobody "fixes" it: the drawing puts -OH at C-1, tert-butyl at C-2 and C-6 and -CH3 at C-4, while the chapter's prose names it 3,5-di-tert-butyl-4-hydroxytoluene. Those are the SAME molecule numbered from phenol and from toluene respectively, so the book agrees with itself; it is not an error.
